question: Where is the Sariska Tiger Reserve located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

Key Points__**

__
 
• Sariska Tiger Reserve is located in Aravali hills and forms a part of the Alwar District of Rajasthan.
 
• Sariska was declared a wildlife sanctuary in 1955 and was declared a tiger reserve later in 1978, making it a part of India's Project Tiger.
 
• Sariska Tiger Reserve is immensely rich in flora and fauna and is famous for Royal Bengal Tiger.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• There are a total of 53 tiger reserves throughout India.
 
• Project Tiger was launched by the Government of India in the year 1973 to save the endangered species of tiger in the country. 
 
• Starting from nine (9) reserves in 1973-to 2016 the number is grown up to fifty-three (53).
 
• **Guru Ghasidas National Park **is the 53rd Tiger Reserve In India as of 2023
